name: bugfix-fast
description: Collect labelled bug reports, fix each one with a test that fails without the fix, and open a pull request for a person to merge.

author.description: Writes the fix and the test that proves it.

verify.description: Runs the project's tests on a clean checkout. Exits 0 only when they all pass.

open-pr.description: Pushes the run's branch and opens a pull request for it. Exits 0 when the pull request exists.

protected.description: The change touches no CI, agent config or lock file.

tests-kept.description: No test was deleted, skipped or stripped of its checks.

verify.description: The workspace's own verify command passes on a fresh checkout.

floor.description: At least as many tests run as on the base commit.

proves-fix.description: The new test fails without the fix.

agent.prompt: Find the root cause of the bug in the task. Write a test that fails because of it, then the smallest fix that makes the test pass. Commit both. In your hand-off, say what the cause was and name the test.

cause.description: The root cause, in one sentence.
